dish: IPA-heavy draft list (hazy and West Coast) plus Mexican lagers and Belgian-style ales — 16 to 20 taps — with a pub menu
w: Lodge-style 10-barrel brewery opened in 2018 by four homebrewing friends, with a two-tier 3,500-sq-ft patio over the Cuyahoga River. On Cleveland Scene's 35 Ohio breweries worth the drive, Cleveland Magazine's Cuyahoga Falls best-restaurants-and-bars guide and Akron Life's riverfront-patio pick.

dish: Fish and chips and clam chowder; patio lobster rolls and peel-and-eat shrimp
w: Lakeside restaurant on East Twin Lake in the former Twin Lakes Tavern (Akron Beacon Journal review). Voted a Best Restaurant in Portage County (#3) in Akron Life's 2026 330 Flavor Awards; in the Beacon Journal's Greater Akron waterfront-restaurants roundup.
